report:
Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m.
kvadricepsa.
Prednji križni ligament je mukoidno degeneriran.
Veći vanjski i unutarnji oteofiti femorotibijalnog i FP zgloba.
Lateralni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Stanje po kompleksnoj rupturi stražnjeg korijena i roga medijalnog meniska koji se u prikazanom
segmentu ne prikazuje uz ekstruziju diska.
Interkondilarno uz ventralni korijen medijalnog meniska vidi se lezija nešto višeg intenziteta
signala od meniska dimenzija 4 x 2 mm - moguće flap meniska.
Potpuno je reducirana hrskavica medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba uz vidljiv
subhondralni koštani edem medijalnog kondila femura i platoa tibije - hondoromalacija IV.
stupnja.
Hondromalacija III. stupnja lateralnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba.
Patela je mediponirana, Wiberg 1 uz vidljivu hondromalaciju II. stupnja femoropatelarnog zgloba
dominantno medijalne fasete patele i medijalne trohleje femura.
Bakerova cista aksijalno dimenzija oko 21 x 28 mm (APxLL).
Multilokulirana ganglion cista straga interkondilarno uz stražnji rog lateralnog meniska promjera
oko 6 mm.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Kranijalniji položaj patele, Insall-Salvatti omjer 1,6. Tetiva m. quadriceps je valovitog tijeka uz
prisutan edem i prekid kontinuiteta vlakana u medijalnom dijelu, u smislu parcijalne rupture.
Manja količina izljeva u lateralnom i suprapatelarnom recesusu uz edem suprapatelarnog masnog
jastučića.
Edem potkožnog masnog tkiva prepatelarno.
Edem patelarnog hvatišta lateralnog patelarnog retinakuluma u smislu distenzije uz manju zonu
koštanog edema patele uz hvatište.
Primjeren izgled patelarnog ligamenta.
Početne degenerativne promjene FT zgloba s manjim rubnim osteofitima i stanjenjem i
hondromalacičnim promjenama I. stupnja hrskavica pripadajućih zglobnih tijela.
Umjerene degenerativne promjene FP zgloba. Denudacija hrskavice lateralne fasete patele.
Hondromalacija III. stupnja medijalne polovine trohlearne hrskavice.
Prednji križni ligament je umjereno degenerativno promijenjen, bez znakova rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Medijalni menisk je primjerenih intenziteta signala, bez znakova rupture.
Lateralni menisk je blaže do umjereno degenerativno promijenjen u području prednjeg roga i
trupa, bez evidentne rupture.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Entezopatske promjene proksimalnog hvatišta lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Burzitis tetive m. popliteus.
Primjeren prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta i burzitis tetive m. semimembranosus.
Ne nalazi se poplitealne ciste.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. There is bone bruise at the lateral femoral condyle.  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is subacute osteochondral injury at medial patellar facet (about 1.3* 1.5 cm). The trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. There is chronic complete tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament, at patellar attachment. 
 The lateral trochlear inclination is 0 degree (normal > 11 degrees). The trochlear facet asymmetry is 39.4 % (normal > 40%). The trochlear depth is 6.5 mm. (normal > 3 mm). Patellar height ratio is 1.2 (normal < 1.3). TTTG distance is 26.6 mm. (normal < 15 mm).   
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of right knee effusion is present. No free osteochondral fragment. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Chronic patellar dislocationrelocation injury of right knee; evidence of  
       Subacute osteochondral injury at medial patellar facet (about 1.3* 1.5 cm). 
  Chronic complete tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament, at patellar attachment. 
  Bone bruise at the lateral femoral condyle.  
 The lateral trochlear inclination = 0 degree/ The trochlear facet asymmetry = 39.4 %/ The trochlear depth = 6.5 mm./ Patellar height ratio = 1.2/ TTTG distance = 26.6 mm. 
  Some amount of right knee effusion.

МР находка: МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. В него се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, която достига до края на менискуса и до ставния хрущял. МР данни за дегенеративна промяна в предния рог на латералния менискус. Предният рог на латералния менискус е с повишен сигнален интензитет. До него се изобразява киста с големина 17/6мм. Вижда се едеме на меките  тъкани в съседство с кистата. Костите, формиращи колянната става, са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Не се намират изменения в хрущяла на фемура, тибията  пателата. Кръстни връзки – интактни. Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис, лигамента на пателата – без особености. Поплитеална ямка - б.о. Заключение: МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. Дегенеративна промяна и киста на предния рог на латералния менискус.

Bone Bruise am posterioren Tibiaplateau bds. und an beiden Femurkondylen auf Höhe des Sulcus terminalis. Vollständige ACL Ruptur. PCL intakt. Ausgeprägte Gelenkerguss. Geringe Auftreibung des MCL an der femoralen Insertion, Partialläsion möglich (7/16). Laterale Kollateralbänder intakt. Komplexe Rissbildung im Innenmeniskushinterhorn und an der Pars intermedia mit anteilig Fortsetzung zur Hinterwornwurzel hin. Letzere mit Abhebung/Schleifenbildung im dorsalen Recessus (3/27). Keine Chondropathie femorotibial und femoropatellar. Quadriceps und Patellasehne intakt. Synoviale Proliferationen.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
  
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. A intact9* intact7* intact8 cm subchondral cyst at tibial spine is present.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is chronic osteochondral injury at medial patellar facet (about 1.4* 1.8 cm). The trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. There is chronic partial fullthickness tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament, at mid substance.  
 The lateral trochlear inclination is 16 degrees (normal > 11 degrees). The trochlear facet asymmetry is 28.9 % (normal > 40%). The trochlear depth is 6.34 mm. (normal > 3 mm). Patellar height ratio is 1.06 (normal < 1.3). TTTG distance is 17 mm. (normal < 15 mm).  
   
 In the intercondylar notch, there is suspected chronic partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 There is chronic sprain of the lateral collateral ligament. The popliteus tendon is intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Minimal amount of knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  History patellar dislocation of left knee by evidence of  
  Chronic osteochondral injury at medial patellar facet (about 1.4* 1.8 cm). 
  Chronic partial fullthickness tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament, at mid substance.  
  Abnormal TTTG distance = 17 mm.  
  Suspected chronic partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.  
  Chronic sprain of the lateral collateral ligament. 
  Minimal amount of knee effusion.

Zentrierte Stellung im rechten Kniegelenk. Gering nach medial dezentrierte Stellung der Patella. Fokal oberflächliche Chondropathie retropatellar (7/13). Gering Knochenmarksödem an der medialen Tibiakondyle sowie der medialen femoralen Kondyle. Bone bruise der medialen Patella. Langstreckig vollschichtig aufgebrauchter retropatellarer Knorpel an der medialen Facette (7/15). 
Keine Ruptur der patellaren Retinacula.
Flächig bis vollschichtige Chondropathie der medialen Femurkondyle (4/25).  Mäßig Gelenkerguss. Kräftige synoviale Proliferationen im suprapatellaren Recessus. Zu [DATE] langsam größenprogrediente rundliche Strukturvermehrung von max. 24 mm Größe, z.B. solide synoviale Proliferation, DD noduläre PVNS möglich (4/15, 9/19). Die Läsion ist in der T2 sowie PD inhomogen hypointens, in der Röntgen-VU ohne Kalzifikationen. 
Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband intakt, kein Shift der Tibia. Gering mucoide Degeneration am Außenmeniskushinterhorn. Horizontale Rissbildung des Innenmeniskushinterhornes (5/29). Laterales Kollateralband intakt. Mediales Kollateralband proximal mit Reizzustand, distal bei Auffaserung und Verdickung proximal der tibialen Insertion möglw. mit Partialruptur (4/20). 
Ödemsignal im Weichgewebe präpatellar. Ausgedehnte polylobulierte Baker-Zyste, cc mind. 12 cm.  Zu [DATE] langsam größenprogrediente rundliche Strukturvermehrung von max. 24 mm Größe, z.B. solide synoviale Proliferation, DD noduläre PVNS möglich (4/15, 9/19). Die Läsion ist in der T2 sowie PD inhomogen hypointens, in der Röntgen-VU ohne Kalzifikationen.

МР находка: Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става се изобразяват с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Хрущялът покриващ ставните повърхности на костите е със запазена цялост. МР данни за руптура на задния рог на медиалния мениск, като последния е с хиперинтезни линеарни лезии в структурата си достигащи долната ставна повърхност. Нормално изобразяване на преден рог на медиален менискус и на латерален менискус. Двете кръстни връзки се проследяват до залавните си места с правилна форма и сингален интензитет.
Двата колатерални лигамента са със запазена цялост. МР данни за ставен излив.
Пателата се представя Wiberg II. Insall-Salvati- 1,19. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – без особености. Визуализира се Бекерова киста с р-р 33/18мм. 
Заключение: Руптура на заден рог на медиален мениск – 3 степен. Ставен излив. Бекерова киста.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs anterior, posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Medial menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ligaman normaldir. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir.Medial kollateral ligamanda periligamantöz ödem izlenmiştir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Femoral kartilajda difüz incelme ve yer yer desktrüksiyon izlenmektedir.Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında hafif darama izlenmiştir.Ekleme komşu femur medial kondilde subkondral alanda 8x3 mm boyutlu osteokondral defekt izlenmiştir.Tibial kartilajda incelmeler izlenmektedir.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde minimal sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Prepatellar düzeyde cilt altı yağ dokuda yaygın ödem izlenmiştir.Sonuç: Gonatroz, femur medial kondilde osteokondral defekt, medial menisküste grade III, lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon, suprapatellar bursa diz ekleminde sinovit, medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain, prepatellar bursit.

FINDINGS:

There is a small knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.

There is full-thickness cartilage loss involving the lateral patellar facet with subchondral reactive and cystic changes. There is also thinning of the cartilage involving the central and lateral portion of the femoral trochlea. There is mild thinning and superficial fraying involving the cartilage of the medial lateral compartments. There are no other regions of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There is severe intrasubstance degeneration involving the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a degenerative horizontal tear. The medial meniscus demonstrates mild intrasubstance degeneration of the body and posterior horn without a well-defined linear tear.

Otherwise the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Moderate degenerative change of the knee most pronounced at the patellofemoral joint as detailed above.

2. Intrasubstance degeneration involving the medial and lateral meniscus more pronounced involving the anterior horn laterally with a degenerative horizontal tear.

3. Small knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.
